title: The Grunion Run, iii
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Third year. Wood brings the dog. The dog loves it. The strip is losing the argument.

panels.composition: The beach, lanterns, the run. BARNABY at the surf line losing his mind at silver fish. GULLY with buckets. WOOD with the pad, and no contempt left.

image.prompt: a night beach festival with lanterns, a small dog going wild at hundreds of silver fish flashing on wet sand, a boy in a backwards cap laughing with buckets, a young man with a drawing pad watching the dog, black and white
close-up of a boy in a backwards cap grinning and needling his friend, lantern light

panels.composition: The pad: Barnaby, mid-leap, a fish, lantern light, in four strokes. The best drawing of the dog yet.
props: pad with a four-stroke dog mid-leap

image.prompt: close-up of a drawing pad with a brush-pen sketch of a small dog mid-leap after a fish in four confident strokes

panels.composition: Silent. The fish. The dog. The lanterns. Wood not drawing. Third year running, the pad closed.

notes: Third Grunion Run. Contempt gone, pad closed, dog in the surf.
